test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) LP-KN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a909c1cfdda1439d0105e20a24bf8904268d60a843e14d0f344ef462a7fb4f47.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85b9e4b2a3f95c5f3b14a663b81d66dc164b0cadc102366dd6b6a179287b8ee9.png] 

Option 2) FJ-EH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23c2404ed747d8e33e01c81e220cce72ed9d44bcf4d0cf51022858f87f521121.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67825dd21f8f06d80b3cb78b814058d1f3787d2a1c1fde394a808adb073b946e.png] 

Option 3) OS-NR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8584ad3170f1c323be869f2de865398cf920ee63785a9397f7bce45ee2129ec1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b0f2a964db7f51f52d974a87274b0075e08dd411de218557add2b240ca019b9.png] 

Option 4) IM-HK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28cc8ccb06b9147b67e1078c5c36d0bd9bd65fff2b2fef88dbd0dfc384df5c46.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fb798f1fca8fadaddfdd1d2ad960d8632c4877c730af8488589bf1c011c951e.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'OS-NR' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
